sentences.en: According to an expert, neither mountaineering nor skiing is dangerous.
sentences.zh: 据专家说，登山和滑雪都不危险。

sentences.en: We cannot but wonder at his skill in skiing.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不惊叹于他在滑雪方面的技巧。

sentences.en: We can enjoy skiing here all the year round.
sentences.zh: 这里一年四季都可以享受滑雪的乐趣。
